title: Zesty Golden Argentinian Seitan Empanadas
description: A sweet and savory Argentinian dish featuring crispy seitan empanadas, perfect for a hangover cure. This vegan-friendly recipe uses high heat cooking oil for a shattering crust.
instructions: Preheat the vegetable oil in a deep frying pan to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together the flour and cornstarch.
Add the chopped onion, minced garlic, paprika, and salt to the bowl and mix well.
Cut the seitan into small sashimi-cut pieces and add to the bowl, mixing until the seitan is well coated.
Using a spoon, drop small balls of the seitan mixture into the hot oil, flattening slightly with a spatula.
Fry the empanadas for 3-4 minutes on each side, until golden brown.
Remove the empanadas from the oil with a slotted spoon and place on a paper towel-lined plate to drain excess oil.
Serve the empanadas hot and enjoy.
